sloka: अभवत् सुदिने चापि दुर्दिनं रूक्षमारुतम् ।ऊचुः खगा मृगाः सर्वे वाचः क्रूरा भयावहाः ।। ६.५५.११ ।।।।
transliteration: abhavat sudine cāpi durdinaṁ rūkṣamārutam ।ūcuḥ khagā mṛgāḥ sarve vācaḥ krūrā bhayāvahāḥ ।। 6.55.11 ।।।।

translations.english: At a time on a good day of fine weather, it became cloudy, birds and beasts were making frightening cries all over.
